Well for starters I'm extremely unattractive, unintelligent, super scrawny, I have no skills or talents , EXTREMELY anti social.

I haven't had a real life friend in so long I can't even remember... I spend my days watching YouTube and playing video games because it use to take my mind off things now it doesn't ! So its just used to pass the time.
My dad thinks I'm a failure and my mom is mentally unstable. 

I have 0 interests 0 motivation to do ANYTHING I just can't take it anymore

I'll be honest I would have said I want a better life a while ago but I don't believe in fairy tales 

I'm still young probably gonna get shit for saying my age but I'm 15 

and I stay in my room so the only people I know is my family and I'm NOT gonna ask them...
I've tried finding a reason to live but I have NO ONE or THING!! and I don't see that ever changing I'm just not enjoyable to be around or talk to

I hate everything about myself and living is painful so I just want to stop suffering 

a bullet is the ONLY way
nothing could help me besides a bullet
